text:
morgan: Quick check — product + eng: for the MVP of a hybrid split-and-merge toolflow, can we support parallel invokes with a deterministic merge ordering? Need concrete launch-gating criteria by EOW.
anika: what do you mean by deterministic — preserve original step order, or order by completion/score?
morgan: preserve original step order unless caller opts into best-score merging. Customers care about predictable traces for audits.
kevin: Tech note: we can execute multiple tool calls concurrently, but merging requires an explicit policy. Practical options: `deterministic_index` (respect input order), `first_success`, or `best_score` (requires extra rerank).
t-s: For best_score we need an embedding/reranker call which adds latency and cost. Also may need batching for efficiency.
miriam: From PM/customer side — ask: low tail latency + consistent ordering. Suggested launch criteria: 95th percentile end-to-end for common 2-step flows < 400ms (hosted), and deterministic merge available for compliance customers.
raj: Ops concern: parallel + retries -> duplicate side-effects on downstream integrations. Need idempotency tokens and per-invoke timeouts as defaults. Recommend per-tool default timeout = 2000ms and require idempotency token header for any side-effecting tool.
anika: config sketch:```
toolflow:
  parallel: true
  merge_policy: deterministic_index
  per_call_timeout_ms: 2000
  retry_policy: idempotent
  max_retries: 1
```
morgan: Nice. Also we need a canary rollout plan (10% traffic, 24h observability window, auto rollback on error spikes).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary created — toolflow-v1 on 10% traffic :rocket:
kevin: Implementation risks: KV-cache semantics for partial responses and token accounting during concurrent KV reads/writes. Likely need a final synchronous merge stage which may add ~50–120ms depending on merge complexity.
miriam: That's acceptable if we keep the 95p SLO. For Enterprise EA: require deterministic merge + audit trail of merge decisions and per-invoke logs.
t-s: Quick design decision on retries: do we retry synchronously (blocking) or schedule background retries? Blocking hurts latency; background hurts determinism unless we record it.
anika: prefer optimistic non-blocking retries by default (best-effort), but expose `sync_retry=true` behind a flag for critical integrations.
morgan: Action items: 1) eng to prototype `deterministic_index` and `best_score` merge policies with perf numbers, 2) eng-platform to spec idempotency token + per-invoke timeout surface, 3) product to author launch criteria + EA checklist (determinism, logs, SLOs). I'll sync with security/legal for audit log retention. Follow-up: I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
